title: Sprint status undercounts reservations and stale claims past the limit
description: Evidence: sprint status builds full memberIds, then slices to --limit before computing counts, reservation membership, top blockers, and stale claims; JSON does not expose totalDescendants/truncated. Impact: large sprints can show clean/smaller status while open work or stale active claims exist beyond the first page.
acceptanceCriteria: Aggregate counts, reservations, blockers, and stale claims over the full sprint scope; limit only detail rows.
JSON/human output exposes totalDescendants, inspected detail count, limit, and truncated, with tests for stale claims beyond the detail limit.
